questions_and_answers.question: _____ is a type of investing strategy in which you purchase a collection of bonds with different maturities spread out over your investment horizon. a. Laddering b. Buy-and-hold c. Indexing d. DRIP
questions_and_answers.answer: Option a. is the right answer choice. Explanation: Laddering is a type of investing strategy in which one purchases a collection of bonds with different maturity dates. The investment technique is popular among investors as it has the capability to minimize the risk of market fluctuation or volatility. Due to the diversification of investment funds in multiple stocks with different maturities, the risk gets reduced and the chances of earning high returns are increased. Explanation for incorrect answers Buy and hold is the investment technique in which the investor buys the stocks and holds them for a longer period of time. Indexing is a passive investment strategy and includes greater diversification with minimum cost. DRIP is an investment technique in which dividends are reinvested into stocks.
